property_summary: For any fuzzed candidate, a successful transferOwnership(newOwner) must set owner() exactly to newOwner and that newOwner must be non-zero (transferOwnership to the zero address must revert); the mutant accepts transferOwnership(address(0)), after which owner() no longer matches a valid transferrable owner and the revert guarantee is lost.
change_summary: Delete the require that rejects the zero address so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
